req.title: Retrieve player by squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/squadNumber/{squadNumber} with the player wearing that squad number.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} retrieves a player by their squad number. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — a mid-range squad number that exists returns 200 with exact payload; (2) NEG — a squad number that does not exist returns 404; (3) BVA boundary-low — squad number 1 (lowest seeded) returns 200 with exact payload; (4) BVA boundary-high — squad number 26 (highest seeded) returns 200 with exact payload; (5) NEG — squad number 0 (below minimum seeded) returns 404; (6) NEG — squad number 27 (above maximum seeded) returns 404; (7) EP — non-integer path segment returns 422; (8) DT — verifies all response body fields exactly for a known player to catch field-mapping mutations. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
Squad number 10 exists: Kabir Mary Reddy
expected: Response body contains exact player data for squad number 10
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Mary'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'DM'
    assert body['team'] == 'River Plate'
    assert body['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert body['starting11'] == False
    assert 'id' in body
    assert body['id'] == 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6'

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_full_payload_verification
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
Squad number 3 exists: Kabir Karan Khan with all optional fields populated
actions: Assert every field in the response body matches the seeded row exactly
expected: All fields match exactly: id, firstName, middleName, lastName, dateOfBirth, squadNumber, position, abbrPosition, team, league, starting11
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_squad_number_full_payload_verification():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/3')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == '595b47db-fe68-441b-9ce1-7d2f2bb362a5'
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Karan'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Khan'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1903-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 3
    assert body['position'] == 'Left-Back'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'RB'
    assert body['team'] == 'River Plate'
    assert body['league'] == 'La Liga'
    assert body['starting11'] == True
    assert len(body) == 11
